subject: Post-discovery: quick recap + calendar pairing for intro session
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Johnson <alicia@stackbridge.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: quick recap + calendar pairing for intro session

Hi Alicia — great conversation earlier. Thanks for sharing more about StackBridge's ingestion pipeline and the latency targets you need for the search assistant. Quick recap and suggested next steps below so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: your priority is sub-200ms token latency for interactive search, tight budget for inference spend in Q4, and strong auditability for PII redaction.
- Who should attend next: your engineering lead (tech deep dive) + one product manager to align on success criteria.
- Goal of next meeting: 30-minute product intro focused on fit + a short tech checklist so Soojin can advise on model/quantization choices.

Can you confirm the right two stakeholders on your side? If so, please pick one of the time windows below (all times PT):

Option A — Wed Oct 27, 9:00–9:30am PT (good for West Coast engineering)
Option B — Thu Oct 28, 11:30–12:00pm PT (midday, better for product folks on East Coast)
Option C — Fri Oct 29, 4:00–4:30pm PT (short block for exec-aligned overview)

If none of these work, share two 30-minute windows and we’ll do our best to pair calendars. I’m copying Soojin (technical lead) and Priyom (CS) so they can jump in on timing and any pre-demo asks. I’ve attached the discovery notes and our short one-pager for context.

Next steps if you pick a slot: I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a prep checklist for the tech call (sample prompts, dataset pointers, and a short security note).

Thanks again — excited to continue.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0116

Attachments: 20261020-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call), redwood-one-pager-v3.pdf

---

From: Alicia Johnson <alicia@stackbridge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@stackbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: quick recap + calendar pairing for intro session

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming attendees from StackBridge: myself (Product), David Lee (Engineering Lead). We can do Option B — Thu Oct 28 at 11:30am PT.

Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can Soojin share a short checklist on what infra info David should have ready (GPU types, current model sizes, and a sample query profile)?
2) We need a brief note about data handling — specifically whether Redwood supports keeping KV cache off for certain contexts and what logs you surface for audit. If you can include that in the invite notes, helpful.

If Soojin prefers another time, let us know. Otherwise, lock Option B and send a calendar invite.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Johnson
Senior Product Manager, StackBridge
alicia@stackbridge.io

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Johnson <alicia@stackbridge.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, David Lee <david.lee@stackbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: quick recap + calendar pairing for intro session

Perfect — locking Thu Oct 28, 11:30–12:00pm PT. Calendar invite coming in a minute.

Soojin: can you add a 4–6 item prep checklist in the invite notes covering:
- short infra snapshot (GPU family, memory, model size)
- sample traffic profile (qps and typical seq length)
- whether you plan to keep KV cache off for any datasets and implications
- basic audit logs we can show (request IDs, token-level metrics, retention options)
- any redlines on data residency/SSO we should flag early

Priyom: I’ll include a mutual-action-plan stub in the invite (pilot milestones, success criteria, timelines).

Alicia / David: attaching a single-click calendly link for your convenience and the HubSpot opportunity so our CS can track sequencing. If anything changes on your side, reply here and we’ll re-pair calendars.

Thanks all — see you Thursday.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments (sent): 20261020-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-one-pager-v3.pdf
